avis.titre: Lightweight facial oil that hydrates while helping
avis.texte: I've been using the PLZ Clarify Facial Oil for a few weeks and I'm honestly impressed. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving my skin feeling greasy. I have combination skin, and it helped balance my oil while still keeping my face hydrated. I usually use a few drops at night after my moisturizer and wake up with smoother, calmer skin. The consistency is silky and easy to spread, and a little goes a long way.
I really like this face oil! It has helped calm my skin, and I use it before moisturizing my face at night. In the morning, I feel like my skin is glowing!

avis.titre: elf skin.PLZ CLARIFY OIL CHANGE MY MIND.
avis.texte: I'll be honest I wasn't expecting to add a facial oil to my routine I always thought I would make my skin greasy and break me out more. but the elf skin.PLZ CLARIFY OIL CHANGE MY MIND. The first thing I noticed was How light it feels. It's not thick. Or heavy. A couple of drops in my hands, Pressed onto my face After washing, and it absorbs fast. No shiny,slick look. No feeling like I just rubbed cooking oil all over er my face. It actually dries down pretty clean. I deal with some congestion around my nose and chin. And occasional breakouts,specially after work workouts. After using this constantly at night, my skin started looking smoother, less irritated nothing traumatic overnight, but over a week or two notice few random bumps and my pores didn't look as clogged. What I like the most is that it feels simple. It doesn't over complicate things it hydrates, helps keep breakouts in check, and doesn't fight with the rest of my products. I can even use it under moisturizer with that feeling heavy. Now the scent , it's a little herbal kind of a tea tree-ish not terrible but you'll notice it when you first put it on it fades pretty quick though so it's not a big deal
